title: Segway Ninebot ZT3
body_html:
The Segway Ninebot ZT3 Pro is engineered for riders who demand power, range, and rugged reliability. With a high-torque 650W motor (peaking at 1600W), it reaches a top speed of 25 mph, making it ideal for commuting or adventure rides.

Equipped with a 597Wh lithium-ion battery, the ZT3 offers up to 44 miles of range in Eco mode and about 19 miles at full performance. Recharging takes just 4 hours, keeping downtime to a minimum.

Equipped with a 350W motor (peaking at 500W), it reaches a top speed of 20 mph, making it ideal for swift urban travel. Its 36V 10Ah lithium-ion battery offers a range of up to 32 miles on a single charge, ensuring extended rides without frequent recharging. Weighing approximately 34 lbs, the X7 Max features 10-inch pneumatic tires, providing a smooth and stable ride over various terrains. The scooter's IPX4 water resistance rating ensures durability in light rain conditions.

Key Specs:

  • Top Speed: 20 mph
  • Range: Up to 32 miles
  • Weight: 34 lbs
  • Motor: 350W (500W peak)
  • Battery: 36V 10Ah lithium-ion
  • Charging Time: Approximately 6 hours
  • Max Load: 275 lbs
  • Brakes: Front electronic and rear disc brakes
  • Tires: 10" pneumatic
  • Water Resistance: IPX4

The TurboAnt X7 Max combines robust performance with advanced features, making it a top choice for riders seeking a reliable and comfortable electric scooter experience.
